title: Globex Corporation 24/7 DFIR Retainer & Compromise Assessment

sections.heading: Retainer Overview
sections.body:
Globex Corporation seeks a 24/7 digital forensics and incident response retainer covering all global business units.
The retainer replaces all existing incident response arrangements on day one.

sections.heading: Response Time Requirements
sections.body:
Initial remote response within 15 minutes of alert, every day of the year.
On-site responders must reach any Globex facility worldwide within 4 hours of declaration.

sections.heading: Incident Pool And Effort
sections.body:
The vendor shall handle an unlimited number of P1 incidents per year with no reduction in response quality.
A compromise assessment covering 5,000 endpoints shall be completed inside the first 60 days.

sections.heading: Tooling Prerequisites
sections.body:
The vendor shall deploy incident response agents across all 40,000 workstations during onboarding.
Agent rollout must not exceed two weeks.

sections.heading: Commercial Conditions
sections.body:
Payment is 100 percent upon contract signature.
Queries to soc@globex-fictional.example or +91 98765 43210.
